# Goblin, in English

The same creature in English — its name is the same word, so the file
says the language. `Humanoid` picks the cowled figure through the
English pattern; the six-column stat block under the `en` captions. Out
of the German deck. Invented for this deck.

```cardsmith
card:
  system: mini-d20
  card-type: bestiary
  language: en
data:
  name: Goblin
  category: Humanoid
  hit-dice: 1
  hit-points: 4
  armor-class: 12
  saving-throw: 18
  movement: 1
  actions: 1 Weapon (3 Damage)
  abilities:
    - In sunlight the attack roll is reduced by 1.
    - Attacks only when outnumbering and flees at half HP.
  description: "Small, mean and always in the majority."
  image: "[[Goblin.png]]"
  reference: Rules p. 19
```
